entries.32340bfa27f3f3ac: Under its medium-term management plan (fiscal years ended September 2024 through September 2026), the company's basic policy is 'Bringing smiles to the region through everyday eating'. Based on a dominant strategy, it is pursuing share growth through new store openings in the Obihiro, Asahikawa and Sapporo areas and scrap-and-build, strengthening product competitiveness and product development technology, and securing and developing human resources. For the final year, the September 2026 fiscal year, key priorities are strengthening recently opened stores, countermeasures against competing stores and revitalizing existing stores, advancing new store openings, and strengthening governance, among others. The company also intends to strengthen shareholder returns, including through higher dividends and expanded shareholder benefits.
